name: Assetto Corsa Evo (Proton)
author: contact@rxcorp.fr
description:
Assetto Corsa Evo dedicated server via Proton, with the RXCORP web dashboard (default port 8090).

IMPORTANT: Do NOT allocate the dashboard port in Pterodactyl — the dashboard is accessed via the RXCORP reverse proxy.

All game settings (server name, track, cars, sessions, etc.) are managed exclusively through the web dashboard. Do NOT add Pterodactyl variables for game settings — they would be overwritten on every restart.

Persistence and theme injection are baked into the Docker image. No manual build step is required.

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
apt-get update
apt-get install -y curl
echo "Installation complete — server files will be downloaded on first start via SteamCMD."

variables.name: Server TCP Port
variables.description: TCP port for game traffic. Must match the Pterodactyl allocation.

variables.description: UDP port for game traffic. Must match the Pterodactyl allocation. Often the same as TCP.

variables.description: Username for the web dashboard HTTP Basic Auth.

variables.name: Dashboard Password
variables.description: Password for the web dashboard. Leave empty to disable authentication (not recommended).

variables.name: Steam Username
variables.description: Steam account username for SteamCMD. Use a dedicated burner account — credentials are stored in plaintext.

variables.name: Steam Password
variables.description: Steam account password for SteamCMD. Use a dedicated burner account.

variables.name: Steam Guard Code
variables.description: One-time Steam Guard code. Only needed on first login or after a session expires. Leave empty once authenticated.

variables.description: Automatically update the game server via SteamCMD on each startup.

variables.name: Dashboard Port
variables.description: Port for the web dashboard. Make sure you don't allocate this as a game port in Pterodactyl. Default is 8090.
